proposal.summary: The report describes an information disclosure in Wavlink WN530HG4 firmware M30HG4.V5030.191116 where the device's web page set_safety.shtml contains a JavaScript variable syspasswd exposing the username and password without authentication.
proposal.recommended_next_step: Verify on-device behavior and determine whether the exposed credentials provide administrative access; if confirmed, remove credentials from client-side pages and require authentication to access sensitive data. Prepare a patch or guidance to stop embedding plaintext credentials in served pages and rotate affected credentials.

evidence_quotes.claim: Page to view source where secret is exposed
Instruction to find the credential variable
Authentication is not required to view the page
